title: Company structure
subtitle: Arrange hierarchy levels and manage the units of each level.

levels.title: Levels
levels.subtitle: Hierarchy order from top to bottom. Use "+" between two levels to insert a new one.
levels.addDescription: The new level is inserted right below "{{name}}".
levels.name: Level name
levels.deleteConfirm: The "{{name}}" level and all of its units will be deactivated. Continue?

units.name: Name
units.parentHint: Optional. Only units of higher levels can be selected.
units.locationHint: Optional. The branch's physical location (address and country live on the Locations screen).
units.empty: No units in the {{level}} level yet. Use "Add new" to create one.
units.deactivateConfirm: The "{{name}}" unit will be deactivated. Continue?

approvalPolicies.title: Approval processes
approvalPolicies.hint: Optional fields. A request type left empty is inherited from the parent unit.
approvalPolicies.defaultFirstManager: No process assigned; requests go to the employee's first manager.
approvalPolicies.workflowUnavailable: Approval processes can be selected once the Workflow module is available.

companies.createDescription: Enter the company name and holiday calendar. The calendar applies to every unit down to the lowest level of the company.
companies.holidayCalendarHint: Public holidays come automatically from this calendar and are listed on the home page.

authorization.title: Unit authorization
authorization.subtitle: Authorized people for the "{{name}}" unit
authorization.explainScope: The authorization applies to this unit and all of its sub-units. The same person can be authorized for several units.
authorization.explainAbilities: The authorized person can list, open and update employee cards in these units and add new employees to them.
authorization.explainCustomReports: "Build your own" reports are never available to unit managers.
authorization.empty: No one is authorized for this unit yet.
authorization.canViewSalary: Can access employees' payment and salary information
authorization.canViewReports: Can access their own unit's reports
authorization.flagRequired: At least one option must be turned on.
authorization.removeConfirm: {{person}}'s authorization for the "{{unit}}" unit will be removed. Continue?

calendars.subtitle: Manage the public and company-specific holiday calendars assigned to companies.
calendars.recurringLabel: Repeat on the same day every year
calendars.createDescription: Create a calendar for your company, then add holidays and assign it to a company.
calendars.name: Calendar name
calendars.countryCodeInvalid: Select a country from the list.
calendars.halfDayHint: When ticked, leave counting deducts 0.5 day for this date.
calendars.deleteEntryDescription: The holiday "{{name}}" will be permanently removed from the calendar.
calendars.deleteCalendarDescription: The calendar "{{name}}" and all its holidays will be permanently deleted. A calendar assigned to a company cannot be deleted.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission for this action.
errors.levelSystemImmutable: The Company level is a system level and can't be deleted.
errors.levelInUse: This level can't be deleted because its units have active employees.
errors.unitHasChildren: This unit has active sub-units and can't be deactivated. Move or deactivate the sub-units first.
errors.unitHasActiveEmployees: This unit has active employees and can't be deactivated.
errors.parentCycle: The selected parent unit would create a cycle.
errors.locationInUse: The location is linked to an active unit.
